changes.comment: New `store.instrumentEffects(observer, options?)` (with `InstrumentedEffects`, `InstrumentedEffect`, `EffectsObserver`): once every effect for an event has settled, reports each effect's name, origin, duration and whether it failed, plus the whole phase's duration and the clock time. Nothing is timed while no observer is registered; ephemeral events reach only observers that opt in; a throwing observer is reported as `observer-error`.
